items.exampleEn: It is very hot in summer.
I want to be a doctor in the future.
The flowers are beautiful in spring.

items.sentenceEn: We usually eat dinner at seven.

items.audioEn: We usually travel in spring. This year, we will go in summer.
items.audioZh: 我們通常春天去旅行，今年我們會在夏天去。
items.questionZh: 他們今年什麼時候去旅行？

items.sentenceEn: There is a party at eight tonight.
What do you want to do in the future?

items.stemEn: I ____ have tea in the morning.

items.passageEn: Ben is ten years old. He usually gets up at seven and goes to school at eight. In summer, he swims in the sea with his father. In spring, he plays baseball. Tonight, his family is going to a concert. In the future, he wants to be a singer.
items.passageZh: Ben 十歲。他通常七點起床，八點上學。夏天他和爸爸在海裡游泳，春天他打棒球。今晚他們全家要去聽音樂會。他將來想當歌手。

items.promptZh: 我今晚要和朋友吃晚餐。
referenceEn: I will have dinner with my friends tonight.
I am having dinner with a friend tonight.
rubricZh: 今晚的計畫用表示未來的寫法（例如 will have、am having、am going to have）
「和朋友」用 with（例如 with my friends、with a friend）

items.instructionZh: 用 usually 造一個句子，說說你週末通常做什麼。
referenceEn: I usually sleep late on the weekend.
On the weekend, I usually go to the park.
rubricZh: usually 常放在一般動詞前（例如 usually go），也可放句首（例如 Usually, I …）
習慣性的事用現在簡單式
「週末」可寫 on the weekend、on weekends 等
